candidates.sql:
WITH ranked AS (
 SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY event_id ORDER BY received_ts_ms, ingest_id) AS rn FROM raw_events
), times AS (
 SELECT user_id, attempt_id,
 MIN(CASE WHEN event_name='click' THEN event_ts_ms END) AS click_at_ms,
 MIN(CASE WHEN event_name='ready' THEN event_ts_ms END) AS ready_at_ms,
 MIN(CASE WHEN event_name='fail' THEN event_ts_ms END) AS fail_at_ms
 FROM ranked WHERE rn=1 GROUP BY user_id, attempt_id
)
SELECT user_id, attempt_id, click_at_ms, ready_at_ms, fail_at_ms,
 CASE WHEN ready_at_ms IS NOT NULL THEN 'success' WHEN fail_at_ms IS NOT NULL THEN 'fail' ELSE 'open' END
FROM times ORDER BY user_id, attempt_id;
